what_happened: Scene: layout 9 (dark-blue cabinets, white tiles; same kitchen as s0/s2/s3/s13/s26), 5-burner gas hob (large 'left' burner, front/rear centre, front/rear right); pan_6 (dark pan, wooden handle with metal ferrule) in the high upper cabinet; target front_center; fish on a plate right of the hob. Stage 0: clean grasp at 110 at the ferrule (handle toward the camera between the fingers, width ~0.056, hold 135-377). The base turned to the hob and the pan was carried in from the right; it passed over front_center (0.171 m at 288) but was lowered farther left and released at 377 straddling the gap between the large left burner and the centre column, 0.088-0.112 m from the 'left' burner centre and 0.233 m from front_center. Stage 1: fish grasped at 486 (lift 0.22 m) and released into the pan at 601 (0.03 m): complete 601-2900. Stage 2: the policy turned the 'left' knob first (0.93 rad at 736, the burner actually under the pan; it stayed 0.57-2.41 to the end), then the task knob front_center to 1.15 rad (2144-2176) and front_right to 0.75 rad (2304-2336). Flames on left and front_center are visible either side of the pan (2200). Stage 2 never held because the pan is not within 0.15 m of front_center.
causal_chain: pan carried past front_center and set down one burner too far left (377; 0.233 m from front_center, 0.11 m from left) -> fish correctly in the pan -> three knobs turned including the task knob -> task burner lit next to the pan, not under it -> fail
self_recovery: none for the pan; it never re-touched it except a brief contact at 1334-1344.
official_criterion_notes: stage2:stove done_intervals [[2153,2900]] = task knob front_center on; the pan is on the neighbouring 'left' burner. Correct behaviour of the official check.
